document.title: docs(agents): drop the PR attribution clause
document.summary: `AGENTS.md` no longer asks agents to end a PR body with the model and harness that did the work.
document.why: PRs ended with three or four attribution lines because Máté's global instructions already add one [retro item 1](source:s1).
